18 November 2026 – 5 January 2027
Prudential Hong Kong Winter Wonderland in Tsim Sha Tsui
Welcome to a brand-new harbourfront celebration as Prudential Hong Kong Winter Wonderland in Tsim Sha Tsui debuts along Victoria Harbour. Centred around the Hong Kong Cultural Centre and surrounding landmarks, this vibrant destination brings together iconic venues for a spectacular showcase of light, music and seasonal art.
Light Show​
Experience a harbourfront multimedia spectacle across the Hong Kong Cultural Centre, Museum of Art and Space Museum. Projection mapping, synchronised music and immersive storytelling bring to life a Christmas concert inspired by the northern lights.
